programme.desc: 'S10/E25 - Tour de Chance'. The girls have a newlywed-themed surprise for Emily. Rene reels in a huge locker, while Darrell tests his bicycle knowledge... and wins.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E26 - The Wild Wild Vests'. The oldest facility in Los Angeles is where the newest buyers make their debut. Brandi and Jarrod try to piece their way to a win.

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: 'S14/E12 - Changing Of The Guard'. Tom goes for one final ride on the trapline to pull his last sets before passing the torch to Sean and Hank, Jake has a showdown for the ages when three lions are cornered in a single tree.

programme.title: Swamp Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Voodoo Hogs'. Troy gets a call from a local rancher with a huge problem. Feral hogs are tearing his property apart, and no matter what he does, he can't get rid of them. Some say the ranch is cursed.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: 'S12/E4 - Enemy Roads'. Todd hauls a massive machine as he fights his way home in a final showdown with his nemesis - the infamous Asheweig Road. After a risky brake fix during her longest run of her season.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S25/E5 - Boyz II Pawn Stars'. Rick swings for the fences on some major league memorabilia from one of baseball's best. Corey and Chum go to the end of the road authenticating a Boyz II Men jacket.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Atacama Alien & Chimu Child Sacrifice'. In Chile's Atacama Desert, a mysterious six-inch skeleton sparks debate over alien origins. Deep in the Gobi Desert, ruins of Khara-Khoto reveal a vanished Silk Road civilization.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Million Mummy Necropolis & The Enigmatic Horseshoe'. An ancient cemetery in Egypt yields over a million naturally preserved burials. In France, a horseshoe-shaped monument reveals links to ancient weaponry and ritual.

programme.title: Deadman's Curse
programme.desc: 'S3/E4 - The Germans Are Coming'. Could treasure hunter Daryl Friesen's arch enemy hold the key to finding Slumach's gold? Gold hunter Anton Lennartz and his team return to the Pitt to find the gold and claim the glory.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E44 of 50 - The Gaucho's Revenge'. In this competition we pay homage to the cowboys of South America: the Gauchos. Four smiths lasso up their skills to recreate the iconic Gaucho knife.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E42 of 50 - Flip The Forge'. In this competition the judges flip the script once again, letting the bladesmiths choose their challenge. Will they take it easy or go big to impress the judges?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S24/E25 - Thunder Pawns'. Rick sees red when a Rolex Submariner hits the counter. And later, Rick tries not to explode with joy when he heads to the range to check out a set of Bolivian thunder mugs.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E27 - Out Of The Frying Pan Am'. The buyers hit Dan's home town, and the Vegas Ladies' locker really takes off. Kenny's purchase sets his wallet alight.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E28 - Some Don't Like It Hot'. It's the hottest day ever in Riverside and Kenny starts seeing things. Ivy gives Mary a boost, while Shana and Edwina stumble across their own paradise.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S10/E29 - Season Of The Kitch'. In Victorville, Brandi and Jarrod's mischievous side emerges. Ivy grabs a locker that no one else can tolerate, while Mary puts the new guy in his place.

programme.title: The Last King Behind The Iron Curtain
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. This is the never before told story of Romania's 23-year-old King Michael who, by defying Hitler in WW2, risked his life, only to be ejected from his homeland by Communists imposed from the Kremlin.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E8 - Swamp Vets'. Jacob and Little Willie hunt a legendary cannibal gator known as Bone Crusher. Bruce and Anna hide their lines to stay one step ahead of poachers, forcing Bruce to rely on his uncanny swamp memory.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Hidden Temple Of Athribis & Ice Age Footprints'. In Egypt, a cliffside temple devoted to a lion-headed goddess emerges from the rubble.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - King Thutmose II Tomb & Secret Saudi Gates'. Royal tomb of King Thutmose II is uncovered in Egypt's Valley of the Kings, offering fresh insights into the Eighteenth Dynasty.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - A Dream Of Great Success'. After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Coral Sea.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - I Shall Never Look Back'. The war enters its third year with battlefields in Eastern Europe, North Africa and the Asia/Pacific. The Battle of Midway, a battle with irreversible consequences, is a victory for the USA.
